items.name: Preventive Medicine
items.blurb: Vaccination schedules, deworming and wellness checks for dogs, cats and exotic pets.

items.name: Clinical Medicine
items.blurb: Consultations, diagnosis and treatment plans. Walk-ins accepted, second opinions welcome.

items.name: Vet Pharmacy
items.blurb: Prescription medicines, parasite control, supplements, therapeutic diets and e-collars on site.

items.name: Exotic Animal Centre
items.blurb: Birds, rabbits, turtles, reptiles, guinea pigs and hamsters, examined, diagnosed and operated on with species-appropriate care and gaseous anaesthesia.

items.name: Pathology Lab
items.blurb: In-house blood panels, urinalysis and cytology. CBC and biochemistry ready in 15–20 minutes.

items.name: Digital X-Ray
items.blurb: On-site digital radiography with instant images, for dogs, cats and exotic patients alike.

items.name: Sonography
items.blurb: Ultrasound imaging at the clinic, including pregnancy confirmation.

items.name: Dog Neutering
items.blurb: Routine same-day neutering under gas anaesthesia, with pre-surgery bloodwork in our own lab.

items.name: Cat Spaying
items.blurb: Safe spaying for female cats, with a 10-day suture check.

items.name: Soft Tissue Surgery
items.blurb: Hernia, cherry eye, anal gland and bladder surgery.

items.name: Orthopedic Surgery
items.blurb: Fracture repair with plating, intramedullary pinning and external fixation.

items.name: Dog Tumor Surgery
items.blurb: Lump evaluation by fine-needle aspirate, surgical removal and histopathology.

items.name: Foreign Body Removal
items.blurb: X-ray confirmation and removal of swallowed objects.

items.name: Emergency Surgery
items.blurb: GDV, trauma and C-sections during opening hours. Call the clinic first so the team can prepare.
